continuity.arc_goal: Implement GET /restate/objects/{service}/{key}/state as a text/event-stream SSE endpoint with transparent repartitioning support. Sessions 1-2 built SSE infrastructure (PartitionStore → StateRouter → HTTP handler). Session 3 designed repartitioning to keep clients connected across partition ownership changes.

progress_update.summary: We completed planning for transparent repartitioning of the SSE State Router. Started with committing prior SSE router code review fixes (14 uncommitted files), then scoped, planned, and tasked out the repartitioning feature. Key design: replace single `objects` map with `HashMap<ServiceId, Subscription>` where Subscription is Pending(Vec<Sender>) or Active(ObjectState). Added Resubscribe variant to SubscriptionRequest. on_partition_closed no longer evicts — active subscriptions survive repartition. add_partition sends Resubscribe for active entries, Subscribe for pending. ObjectState simplified: no partition_id, no initialized, no history; idle_since is plain Instant passed at construction.

constraints: cargo nextest run used for tests per CLAUDE.md
StateRouter::default() is the correct constructor (no new() method)
ObjectState::new takes now: Instant parameter — no Instant::now() inside internals
Lock ordering: never hold objects write lock while awaiting partition_senders send
Empty Pending entries removed immediately in fan_out, not by timer
decisions: Single HashMap<ServiceId, Subscription> enum (not two maps) — eliminates lock ordering complexity
on_partition_closed removes from partition_senders only — active subscriptions untouched during repartition window
Resubscribe sent in add_partition for Active entries; Subscribe sent for Pending entries; never Resubscribe on initial subscribe()
idle_since: Instant (not Option<Instant>) — passed into ObjectState::new, reset when clients drain
StateRouter passed into SpawnPartitionProcessorTask as field — allows task to call add_partition directly on repartition
risks: add_partition does O(n) scan over all active/pending subscriptions to resolve partition — acceptable since repartitioning is rare
